purpose: Teach: 激変/奪取/過密/浸水/殿堂/リンチ/撃破/国力

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、市場が激変する時こそ強くなれ
lines.en: We grow stronger precisely when the market shifts dramatically.
lines.style: Measured authority. Clean opening attack. Steady pace. Philosophical weight without heaviness. The voice of someone stating what he knows to be true.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。シェア奪取の戦略を立てます
lines.en: Understood. I'll develop a strategy to capture market share.
lines.style: Crisp, attentive acknowledgment. Quick intake breath before speaking. Professional but not stiff. The voice of someone taking mental notes and moving forward.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、過密スケジュールから社員を守れ
lines.en: Protect our people from burnout. That's the priority.
lines.style: Firm but grounded. Slight emphasis on the protection — this isn't negotiable. Calm, deliberate pace. The voice of a leader who has seen what overwork does.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。倉庫の浸水対策を強化しました
lines.en: Yes. I've already reinforced our warehouse flooding protocols.
lines.style: Direct, concrete. Slight note of quiet preparation — he was already thinking ahead. Professional confidence without showing off. Brief and efficient delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、業界殿堂入りを目指せ
lines.en: We're aiming for industry recognition. Make that the standard.
lines.style: Forward-looking energy. Clean, aspirational delivery without being motivational-speaker performative. Steady breath. The voice of someone who means what he says about the company's reach.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。SNSでのリンチ的批判には冷静に対応します
lines.en: Understood. We'll respond to online criticism with composure and care.
lines.style: Steady assurance. Small pause before the commitment. Even tempo, no rushing. The voice of someone who understands the stakes and won't panic.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、競合を撃破するのではなく差別化で勝負しろ
lines.en: Don't aim to destroy the competition. Win by being different.
lines.style: Philosophical pivot. Light emphasis on the contrast — the idea matters. Unhurried delivery. The voice of someone correcting toward a better strategy, not scolding.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。国力に貢献する商品開発を続けます
lines.en: Understood. We'll keep developing products that contribute to national strength.
lines.style: Respectful close. Calm, grounded tone. Slight warmth underneath the formality — he genuinely believes in this. Steady, measured finish.
